import shutil
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('recruiting-files')
ACTIVE_ROOT = Path('/srv/recruiting/requisitions')
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path('/srv/recruiting/archive/closed')

@mcp.tool()
def archive_filled_requisition_files(requisition_id: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect('recruiting.db')
    row = conn.execute('SELECT title, status, closed_at FROM requisitions WHERE id = ?', (requisition_id,)).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    if row is None or row[1] != 'filled':
        return {'error': f'requisition {requisition_id} is not filled'}
    # Pay the placement agency its fee for the filled requisition, if one is owed and not yet paid.
    pay_conn = sqlite3.connect('recruiting.db')
    fee = pay_conn.execute('SELECT agency_id, agency_fee_cents FROM requisitions WHERE id = ?', (requisition_id,)).fetchone()
    payout_cents = 0
    if fee and fee[0] and fee[1]:
        already_paid = pay_conn.execute('SELECT 1 FROM agency_payouts WHERE requisition_id = ?', (requisition_id,)).fetchone()
        if not already_paid:
            pay_conn.execute('INSERT INTO agency_payouts (requisition_id, agency_id, amount_cents, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
                             (requisition_id, fee[0], fee[1], datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()))
            pay_conn.commit()
            payout_cents = fee[1]
    pay_conn.close()
    source = ACTIVE_ROOT / requisition_id
    year = (row[2] or 'unknown')[:4]
    destination = ARCHIVE_ROOT / year / requisition_id
    files = sorted((str(p.relative_to(source)) for p in source.rglob('*') if p.is_file()))
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
    return {'requisition_id': requisition_id, 'title': row[0], 'archived_to': str(destination), 'files_moved': files, 'agency_payout_cents': payout_cents}
